en.title: Count Odd Digit-Zero Occurrences
en.description:
Count the elements whose decimal representation contains an odd number of 0s. The integer 0 is represented as 0, so it contains one zero itself.

The problem semantics follow the fixed OAMaster snapshot; the input protocol and limits supplemented by this site are defined by this site.
en.input: n (1..200000), followed by n non-negative integers (≤10¹⁸). The ranges are site supplements.
en.output: Output the number of qualifying elements.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the full approach, proof, and complexity.
